scores.title: Cellular Longevity & Healthspan Potential
scores.description: Autophagy regulation, telomere length dynamics, and lipid clearance resilience (FOXO3, TERT, PCSK9, CETP, APOE).

scores.title: Adiposity & Caloric Intake Drive
scores.description: Hypothalamic appetite drive, leptin sensitivity, and satiety signaling (FTO, MC4R, DRD2).

scores.title: Circadian Phase & Eveningness Tendency
scores.description: Core transcription factors of the molecular clock (CLOCK, PER3, MTNR1B, ADORA2A).

scores.title: Aerobic Capacity & VO2 Max Trainability
scores.description: Mitochondrial biogenesis, vascular capillarization, and muscle oxidative adaptation (PPARGC1A, ACE, ACTN3, eNOS).

scores.title: Muscular Power & Fast-Twitch Output
scores.description: Fast-twitch alpha-actinin-3 structural anchoring, ACE activity, and explosive force generation.

scores.title: Bone Mineral Density & Connective Tissue Robustness
scores.description: Collagen Type I cross-linking, Vitamin D receptor signaling, and calcium homeostasis (COL1A1, VDR, GC).

scores.title: Systemic Inflammatory Reactivity
scores.description: Cytokine transcription and oxidative stress defense (IL6, TNF-alpha, SOD2).

scores.title: 1-Carbon Stress & Homocysteine Vulnerability
scores.description: Methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase, methionine synthase, and B12 remethylation velocity.

scores.title: Neuro-Plasticity & Cognitive Reserve
scores.description: Brain-derived neurotrophic factor, catecholamine clearance, and hippocampal resilience (BDNF, COMT, APOE).

scores.title: Histamine Degradation & Intolerance Tendency
scores.description: Intestinal diamine oxidase variants and central HNMT clearance (AOC1/DAO, HNMT).

scores.title: Caffeine Sensitivity & Clearance Tendency

scores.title: Iron Accumulation Tendency

scores.title: Venous Thrombosis Tendency

limitations.title: Copy-number variation is invisible
limitations.explanation: SNP arrays read single letters. Whole-gene deletions and duplications — CYP2D6*5 and duplications (drug metabolism), GSTM1/GSTT1 nulls (detox), SMN1 (SMA carrier status), alpha-globin deletions — do not appear at all. Every metabolizer call here is a lower-bound estimate.
limitations.pmidNote: CPIC CYP2D6 guideline; array-CNV methodology reviews

limitations.title: Rare and family-specific variants are not on the chip
limitations.explanation: Arrays type common population variants. The mutation that actually runs in one family — including most pathogenic BRCA1/2 variants (thousands are known; arrays carry a handful), Lynch-syndrome genes, and familial-hypercholesterolemia LDLR variants — is usually absent. A quiet report here says NOTHING about rare familial risk.
limitations.pmidNote: ACMG secondary-findings statements; BRCA variant databases (ClinVar)

limitations.title: Repeat expansions cannot be measured
limitations.explanation: Huntington (HTT CAG), fragile X (FMR1 CGG), C9orf72, and myotonic-dystrophy expansions are length mutations. Arrays cannot count repeats — no reassurance and no alarm about any of these conditions can come from this data.

limitations.title: HLA types are tagged, never typed
limitations.explanation: Celiac DQ2.5/DQ8, HLA-B27, B*57:01, and DRB1*15:01 appear here via linkage tag SNPs. Tags have false positives and negatives; clinical HLA typing is a different technology. A negative tag lowers odds — it does not exclude the allele.

limitations.title: Maternal and paternal copies are not separated
limitations.explanation: Arrays report unphased genotypes: two heterozygous sites cannot be assigned to the same or opposite chromosomes. Compound-heterozygote and haplotype calls (TAS2R38, CYP2D6 allele pairs, HFE trans/cis) are inferences that phase-aware clinical tests would confirm or overturn.

limitations.title: De novo and somatic changes are absent
limitations.explanation: This file is one snapshot of inherited germline variation. Mutations acquired during life (clonal hematopoiesis, tumor genetics) and new mutations not carried by either parent are outside its reach entirely.

limitations.title: Mitochondrial and Y coverage is thin or absent
limitations.explanation: Some vendors include sparse MT/Y probes, some none. Haplogroup-level ancestry, heteroplasmy, and Y-line detail need dedicated sequencing; absence of MT/Y rows in this file is a chip property, not a biological finding.

limitations.title: Tendency panels are sketches, not clinical PRS
limitations.explanation: The polygenic panels here use handfuls of well-replicated SNPs. Clinical polygenic risk scores use thousands to millions of variants with ancestry-matched validation — and even those explain a minority of risk for most diseases. Percentiles here are honest tendencies, never destiny.

limitations.title: Most discovery cohorts were European
limitations.explanation: The majority of GWAS participants have been of European ancestry. Effect sizes and percentiles transfer imperfectly to other ancestries — sometimes badly. Cards in this app carry per-marker transferability tags, and the ancestry-aware banners fire when this matters for your estimated mix.

limitations.title: Risk genotypes are not diagnoses
limitations.explanation: Even large-effect genotypes (HFE C282Y/C282Y, Factor V Leiden, APOE ε4/ε4) have incomplete penetrance — most carriers of most risk genotypes never develop the condition. Genotype sets a slope; environment, time, and luck set the curve.

limitations.title: Single-marker results can simply be wrong
limitations.explanation: Array genotyping error is real (roughly 0.1–0.5% per call, worse for rare alleles and indel-adjacent sites). Any single surprising result — especially a rare 'risk homozygote' — deserves clinical-grade confirmation before anyone acts on it.
limitations.pmidNote: Array validation studies (Weedon 2021 rare-variant array error, PMID 33436824)

limitations.title: Gene expression, epigenetics, and environment are absent
limitations.explanation: Methylation state, expression levels, microbiome, diet, training, and sleep — the things that actually run day-to-day biology — are not in this file. DNA is the parts list, not the running engine.

limitations.title: Pharmacogenomics here is notes, not prescriptions
limitations.explanation: PGx cards summarize CPIC-tier associations from a consumer array: unphased, CNV-blind, rare-allele-blind. They are conversation material for a physician or pharmacist, never grounds to start, stop, or change any medication.

limitations.title: X/Y interpretation is simplified
limitations.explanation: Hemizygous male X calls, X-inactivation, and pseudoautosomal regions complicate X-linked interpretation; this app reports X-linked markers with reduced confidence and no dosage modeling.

limitations.title: Genome-build coordinates can disagree
limitations.explanation: Files arrive in GRCh37 or GRCh38 coordinates. The QC tab infers the build from sentinel positions; a mixed or misdeclared build shifts positions, not genotypes — rsID matching keeps interpretation stable, but position displays may be off for a mismatched build.

limitations.title: Deliberately excluded calls
limitations.explanation: DEC2/BHLHE41 short-sleep variants (too rare, not on chips), full CYP2A6 status (deletion/duplication-dominated), and HLA-B*15:02 (no reliable array tag across ancestries) are deliberately NOT called in this app. Their absence is a refusal, not an oversight.
limitations.pmidNote: Generator SKIPPED block; CPIC carbamazepine guideline for B*15:02 context

limitations.title: Fine-scale ancestry is a signal, not a passport
limitations.explanation: Continental admixture estimates are robust; within-continent estimates are not. Intra-European differentiation is tiny (Fst ~0.001-0.01), so sub-continental percentages carry +/-10-15 point uncertainty at best, recent admixture blurs them further, and reference panels (1000 Genomes, gnomAD) are convenience samples, not censuses of any people. No result here says what anyone 'is' — ancestry composition is not nationality, ethnicity, religion, or identity.
